mole.models.multitask_model module

Multi-Task Model for MolE Pretraining

This file defines the components for a multi-task model that combines cross-environment MLM with molecular property prediction.

  • output_size (int)

Returns:

[batch_size, output_size]

Return type:

A tensor of predicted property values. Shape
